entities.name: PMID:10755549
observations: Sykes et al. reported that in vivo T-cell depletion enhances anti-GALalpha1,3GAL natural antibody production in alpha1,3-galactosyltransferase-deficient mice.
The study used depleting anti-CD4 and anti-CD8 monoclonal antibodies in GGTA1/GalT-deficient mice.
T-cell depletion significantly increased serum anti-Gal IgM and total IgM, with increased anti-Gal and total IgM-producing cells in spleen and bone marrow.
T-cell depletion did not significantly increase anti-Gal IgG or total IgG; increased IgM-producing cells were not observed in peritoneal-cavity cells.
The available abstract does not report numerical titers, fold changes, exact dosing schedule, or sampling time points.

entities.name: GGTA1-deficient mice
observations: Mice lacking alpha1,3-galactosyltransferase were used to study anti-Gal natural antibody production.

entities.name: Anti-Gal IgM enhancement
observations: In GGTA1/GalT-deficient mice, in vivo depletion of CD4 and CD8 T cells significantly increased serum anti-Gal IgM and total IgM.
The increase was accompanied by higher anti-Gal and total IgM-producing-cell frequencies in spleen and bone marrow.

entities.name: Anti-Gal IgG unchanged
observations: In GGTA1/GalT-deficient mice, in vivo CD4/CD8 T-cell depletion did not significantly increase anti-Gal IgG or total IgG.
